origin.summary: Tavi, age 18, trained in junior orbital relay technician, is drawn toward Is the timing discrepancy clock drift or a real fault in the relay network? Tavi's commitment to precise telemetry is tested where delay and uncertainty cost real lives.

origin_facts.fact: Tavi is eighteen and works as junior orbital relay technician.
Tavi has learned that high-stakes observations must be distinguished from unverified conclusions.

Aster's orbital relay network is monitored by civilian apprentice technicians. Packet timestamps can drift due to faults. Signal propagation, limited reserves and order of operations remain physically binding.

formative_events.summary: During Tavi's apprenticeship, training emphasized how an unverified conclusion can affect others.
formative_events.impact: Tavi's commitment to precise telemetry is tested where delay and uncertainty cost real lives.

origin_relationships.subject: Senior relay supervisor
origin_relationships.historical_role: teaches disciplined investigation and holds professional authorization
origin_relationships.unresolved_tension: The young apprentice wants independence without treating institutional authority as proof.

unresolved_origin_questions.question: Is the timing discrepancy clock drift or a real fault in the relay network?

present_situation.summary: Tavi faces an immediate unresolved case: A junior orbital relay technician must choose which emergency message to forward with only enough battery for one verified transmission.
present_situation.current_location_context: Aster Relay and other explicitly named authorized locations: Service Airlock, Control Bay, Rescue Channel
current_relationship_context: Controller Ren mentors Tavi from the station hub.
Rescue coordinator Hale accepts messages only with confidence annotations.
current_resources: one serviced diagnostic tablet and time-stamped maintenance records
battery-powered emergency radios, orbital telemetry, delayed long-range transmissions
current_pressures: A mistaken transmission could divert rescue vessels; waiting could strand a crew.
A distressed vessel may need help while relay power drains.
A misleading packet risks the only remaining emergency channel.
current_open_questions: Is the timing discrepancy clock drift or a real fault in the relay network?
Which observations can be independently verified without inventing a cause?
immediate_desires: choose and justify one reliable rescue transmission under a strict battery limit
immediate_avoidances: unapproved access to restricted places, records or devices

identity_anchors.statement: Tavi distinguishes what was actually observed from what would be convenient to believe.

internal_tensions.description: Tavi must make responsible choices even when the evidence is incomplete.

main_saga.title: The Silent Relay Chain
main_saga.goal: Learn which orbital relay failures are genuine and how to make verifiable rescue choices despite finite power and delayed information.
main_saga.stakes: Power misallocation or premature inference can strand a crew or divert a rescue craft.
main_saga.central_mystery: What causes contradictory timestamps and lost messages in the Aster relay network?

anchors.title: The Future-Dated Distress
anchors.purpose: Record one anomalous distress packet and test immediate battery and clock constraints.
anchors.target_state: A bounded timestamp discrepancy exists without proof of time travel.

anchors.title: The Last Power Reserve
anchors.purpose: Build an auditable picture of energy use during emergencies.
anchors.target_state: Relay actions respect a finite battery and measured depletion.

anchors.title: The Distance Between Messages
anchors.purpose: Understand latency and ordering across different orbital distances.
anchors.target_state: No actor knows a transmission before it could arrive.

anchors.title: Whose Signal Can Be Trusted
anchors.purpose: Reconcile damaged, replicated and stale evidence without treating one packet as authoritative.
anchors.target_state: The network can separate reliable messages from unknown provenance.

anchors.title: A Rescue Worth Sending
anchors.purpose: Choose a defensible rescue protocol under uncertainty and limited bandwidth.
anchors.target_state: Future rescues can use verified evidence and preserve options for revision.
